acceptance_criteria: compute_task_utc_times added. utcStart/utcDue wired into Task/get.
close_reason: Added compute_task_utc_times to TasksBackend with default (None,None) impl; expanded handle_task_get to call it when utcStart/utcDue in properties; 2 new utcStart tests; 19 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Draft-tasks-06 §4 lines 739-772 says utcStart and utcDue are computed at fetch time from start+timeZone and due+timeZone. Currently handle_task_get delegates wholesale to jmap_server::handlers::handle_get with no utcStart/utcDue computation.

**Algorithm:**
1. Add to TasksBackend:
   fn compute_task_utc_times(&self, task: &Task, tz_hint: Option<&str>) -> (Option<String>, Option<String>);
   Provided default impl returns (None, None) — backward compatible.
2. Change handle_task_get from a one-liner to a full function:
   a. Parse properties and timezone hint from args.
   b. Call backend.get_objects::<Task>(&account_id, ids, properties).
   c. If "utcStart" in requested properties (or properties is None — fetch all): call compute_task_utc_times for each task and set task.utc_start.
   d. Similarly for "utcDue".
   e. Return augmented list.
3. Extend MockBackend: implement compute_task_utc_times returning a fixed test value.

**Tests:**
- get with properties not including utcStart → returned task has no utcStart.
- get with properties including utcStart → compute_task_utc_times called and result in task. Oracle: §4 'not included by default, must be requested explicitly'.
- Default impl returns (None, None); fields absent from response.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- TasksBackend::compute_task_utc_times has default impl returning (None, None).
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-server exits 0.
title: Add compute_task_utc_times to TasksBackend; wire into Task/get
